summary: Tested Strategy Planner (Entry/Exit Strategy) with auto-alert generation. Backend: 7/7 pytest cases pass — POST/PUT correctly create price_below alerts for entry tiers and price_above alerts for exit tiers. Frontend: sidebar shows 'Strategy Planner NEW' (not 'Exit Strategy'), ENTRY & EXIT STRATEGY page renders, ADD ENTRY (blue #3B82F6) and ADD EXIT (green #00C805) buttons work, both ENTRY TARGETS and EXIT TARGETS sections display, SAVE & CREATE ALERTS button enabled when tiers exist and successfully creates alerts. End-to-end flow login -> Strategy Planner -> create tiers -> save -> alerts persisted verified.

minor.issue: Does NOT delete associated alerts in the alerts collection. Orphan alerts remain after strategy deletion (caused test pollution between fixtures). Should cascade-delete tier alerts.

integration_issues.issue: After saveStrategy() calls fetchStrategies(), selectedAsset/currentStrategy is preserved in state but the side panel switches selection back to the first strategy in the list (e.g., ETH) because the fetch sets selectedAsset only if !selectedAsset. Minor: the user can re-click their just-saved asset to view it. Functional but mildly confusing UX.

action_items: Consider cascade-deleting alerts when a strategy is deleted (DELETE /api/exit-strategy/strategies/{id}).
Minor: after saveStrategy() refetches strategies, ensure the newly saved asset stays selected instead of reverting to first item in list.
critical_code_review_comments: exit_strategy_routes.py POST endpoint inserts alerts BEFORE creating the strategy and only patches exit_strategy_id afterward. If insert_one(strategy) fails, orphan alerts remain. Wrap in transaction or insert strategy first.
ExitStrategyDashboard.js fetchStrategies useCallback has selectedAsset in deps but conditionally sets it; this can cause stale state on rapid re-renders. Consider removing selectedAsset dependency.

Backend uses hardcoded notification_method='email' in POST while PUT also hardcodes it — but UI doesn't expose this. Once Telegram is the primary channel per /app/memory/test_credentials.md, default should arguably be 'telegram'.
seed_data_creation: Created and cleaned up test strategies for symbol TESTCOIN, TESTUI (frontend test left a TESTUI strategy and 2 alerts in DB).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Strategy Planner tab fully working. Backend POST/PUT /api/exit-strategy/strategies correctly auto-creates price_below alerts for entry tiers (tier_type='entry') and price_above alerts for exit tiers (tier_type='exit'). Sidebar correctly labeled 'Strategy Planner' with NEW badge via data-testid='nav-exit-strategy'. Header reads 'ENTRY & EXIT STRATEGY'. Two main issues observed: (1) DELETE strategy leaves orphan alerts; (2) UI reverts asset selection to first item after save. Frontend test left TESTUI strategy + 2 alerts in DB for mobiletest user — clean up if needed.
rca of the issue: Not applicable — feature verified working as designed. Two minor improvements suggested above.
